targets.mean: arithmetic mean of four slots without rounding

information_time: after observation of t-1 hour; record availability without reporting delay assumed
retraining: once per split; hourly observed inputs updated during evaluation; no fitting on evaluation labels

splits.name: later_jul_aug
splits.role: later evaluation after development freeze; already observed period

comparison: primary cross-model and A/B/C comparisons use identical common training and evaluation rows; core A/B is supplementary coverage comparison, never mixed with common scores

missing_policy.required_lag: no imputation; exclude from corresponding comparison pool and record each reason
missing_policy.weather: M03 D only: median and missing indicator fit on training rows, reused on same evaluation rows; all-missing training feature omitted with reason; no future interpolation
missing_policy.no_core_history: learned A/B require lag1 and lag2 and abstain if either missing; a historical baseline can still use its own available lag; abstain only if none of that baseline's allowed lags exists; fallback scores separated from common comparison

prediction_postprocessing: none in initial comparison; negative predictions, if any, diagnosed rather than silently clipped

development_selection.primary: pooled MAE across three development evaluation months; report each month, RMSE and daily-maximum under/overprediction separately
development_selection.near_tie: within 1 percent of lowest pooled MAE, prefer simpler candidate (Ridge before HGB, ridge_10 before ridge_1, hgb_7 before hgb_15); numerical convention, not economic optimum
development_selection.input_ablation: fix model settings within each A/B comparison; no simultaneous tuning and feature changes
development_selection.final_tradeoff: set explicit MAE and overprediction tolerances using development evidence before later evaluation; not decided in M01
development_selection.adaptation: changes encouraged when supported by development results; version contract and record reason before next comparison

repetition: full daily 96-slot profile for posthoc overlap/weight only; no input, no global fitting or deletion; normalize inverse profile counts within each evaluation pool
daily_maximum: only dates with 24 valid targets and 24 eligible evaluation hours; weight ties to sum 1 per date; report excluded dates
